# Vulkan C headers

From KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers tag `v1.3.290`:
`https://codeload.github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/zip/refs/tags/v1.3.290`.
Archive SHA256: `918a8bb31b8312fd649fd1d1826443da870f33f3187c16c4528aa94927409bab`.

Only the C declarations needed by Windows and their video-structure includes
are retained. Copyright notices, `LICENSE.md` and `LICENSES/` are preserved.
No Vulkan loader or GPU driver is shipped. Entry points are resolved from the
installed loader/device.
